faq.q: What is the difference between Grok Plus and Premium?
faq.a: Premium has 4x the usage of Plus and adds Grok Bot, the latest Grok models, image and video creation, cloud agents and code hosting, according to x.ai/pricing.

faq.q: How much is Grok Plus vs Premium?
faq.a: Plus is $8 a month or $80 a year. Premium is $30 a month or $300 a year, before tax.

faq.q: Do Grok Plus and Premium include X Premium?
faq.a: Both include X features. Plus has the Premium checkmark and fewer timeline ads; Premium adds ad-free scrolling on most of X.

pairs.name: Grok Premium vs Super

faq.q: How much more is Grok Super than Premium?
faq.a: Super is $100 a month and Premium is $30, so $70 a month more. Yearly it's $1,000 against $300.

faq.q: What does Grok Super add over Premium?
faq.a: xAI lists 15x Plus usage instead of 4x, 1080p 15-second videos, faster replies and priority access at peak times.

faq.q: Is SuperGrok the same as Grok Super?
faq.a: xAI doesn't say so. New website customers choose Plus, Premium, Super or Ultra, existing SuperGrok plans continue, and the iPhone app still sells SuperGrok.

openIssues: grok.com shows a first-month 50% offer on Premium and Super; regular prices are used.
